name: @lumen/angular
description: Lumen Angular — standalone Angular components implementing the same component specifications as @lumen/ui and @lumen/web-components. Ships 9 components (Button, AIButton, SplitButton, FilterChip, ChoiceChip, SegmentedControl, KPICard, Footer, ThemeToggle). See docs/roadmap.md Phase 13 and this package's README for a known Button-contract drift against @lumen/ui.
